name: Joses/Joseph (Jesus' brother)
title: Half-brother of Jesus
summary: Joses (also called Joseph) was one of Jesus' half-brothers, the son of Mary and Joseph. He is mentioned among Jesus' siblings in the Gospels but played no prominent role in the early church compared to his brother James.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Jesus' brother in Nazareth
keyEvents.description: When Jesus taught in the synagogue of his hometown, the people were amazed and asked if this was not the carpenter's son, mentioning his brothers including Joses.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Gospel of Mark
keyEvents.description: Mark confirms that Joses was one of Jesus' brothers when the people of Nazareth discussed Jesus' family and origins.

keyEvents.title: Mary, mother of Joses, at the cross
keyEvents.description: At Jesus' crucifixion, Mary, the mother of James and Joses, stood nearby watching from a distance. This confirms the family relationship and Mary's presence at the cross.

keyEvents.title: Witness to Jesus' burial
keyEvents.description: Mary, the mother of Joses, was present and saw where Jesus was laid in the tomb, which shows the family's involvement in the events surrounding Jesus' death.
